intent: Review the compact bilingual homepage private-celebrations package card before release.

visual_evidence.scope_reason: The new card introduces image, price, disclosure, and two direct actions in a phone viewport.
visual_evidence.correction_excerpt: keep every remaining touch target at least 44 px.
visual_evidence.comparison: Review evidence/private-celebrations-390x844.png against the stated mobile contract.

brief.visitor: A South Florida resident planning a private social celebration.
brief.promise: Find the event option, starting price, guide, and quote action without a long sales page.
brief.primary_action: Open WhatsApp with a celebration quote message already started.
brief.friction: Visitors need to know where to start without mistaking an illustrative image for client proof or a starting price for a fixed event quote.

kpi.evidence: new CTA event is explicit in server markup
kpi.decision_rule: retain only if inquiry quality is acceptable

concept.idea: One compact social-celebrations card in the existing production route.
concept.brand_reason: Uses the established editorial card grammar and published package price.
concept.interaction: Native details reveals scope lines; actions remain direct links.
concept.visible_response: The disclosure chevron rotates and the actions are visible below the scope lines.
concept.alternatives: No standalone homepage carousel or modal.

story.opening: Fiestas y celebraciones / Parties and celebrations.
story.action: Open details or use the quote and guide links.
story.consequence: Visitor reaches a guide or begins a scoped quote.
story.next_step: Provide date, place, and event type in WhatsApp.

content.visible: Title, owner-set starting price, short explanation, guide and quote actions.
content.optional_html: Three scope bullets in native details.

references.avoid: False project proof, fixed-event price claims, decorative UI that hides the primary action.

components.reuse: HomeProjectPath, Image, Link, packages price/WhatsApp helpers.
components.local_reason: The card belongs in the existing production chooser.

verification.motion: Native disclosure only; respects reduced motion through existing CSS.
verification.accessibility_performance: Alt labels illustration; touch targets at least 44px.
verification.raw_html: Check guide href and WhatsApp URL in rendered HTML.
verification.conversion_boundary: Follow direct WhatsApp href, not a simulated lead claim.

learning.baseline_source: No comparable private-celebration inquiry baseline is available in this session
learning.baseline_value: UNKNOWN: no comparable private-celebration inquiry baseline is available in this session
learning.hypothesis: A compact, clear package card will create qualified inquiries.
